name: tiedout
description: Match bank statements to invoices from local CSV files. MCP server and CLI; your data stays on your machine.
author: Giulliano Macedo (https://github.com/GillMacedo)

scripts.build:
esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=plugin/dist/tiedout.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
